title: Lantern.Reach.S01E03.EndBelowBegin.2026.1080p.WEB-DL.H264-TESTGRP
description: The field payload in 28 articles, the 14th of which states an =ypart end= one below its begin=. SABnzbd drops a range like that and writes the body after the part before it, which is where it belongs, so the file must come out byte-equal.
